title: Design System: YaoHeng Heavy Commercial Truck Showroom

display.purpose: Hero headlines, model names, and high-emphasis numeric values.

body.purpose: Readable commercial explanation and model summaries.

label.purpose: Badges, spec labels, navigation metadata, and compact controls.

shadows.name: truck-drop
shadows.purpose: Grounding vehicle images in the stage.

motion.name: micro-hover
motion.purpose: Buttons, language options, cards, and model stage hover response.

motion.name: carousel-transition
motion.value: duration 0.72s, x shift, scale, rotate, opacity
motion.purpose: Smooth truck image transition with physical layer change.

rules: Engineering orange should remain a scarce calibration mark, not a broad theme.
Truck imagery must be large, angled, local, and physically grounded.
No purple gradients, glassmorphism, neon, cyberpunk, cheap ecommerce, or sports-car drama.
Use metal-like depth through border, inset highlight, shadow, and perspective.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main sales action for quote and advisor flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #e86f1d; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(232,111,29,0.24); transition: transform 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f17a24; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Industrial Badge
components.description: Compact technical label for sections, truck types, and specs.
components.css: .ds-badge-industrial { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(232,111,29,.45); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(232,111,29,.10); color: #e86f1d; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Model Showcase Card
components.description: Hot-model product card with 3D truck stage and procurement specs.
components.css: .ds-model-card { border: 1px solid rgba(100,116,139,.24); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.95); box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(71,85,95,.12), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.96); overflow: hidden; } .ds-topline { height: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e86f1d, rgba(232,111,29,.38), transparent); } .ds-stage { min-height: 244px; perspective: 900px; }

components.name: Language Selector
components.description: Compact multilingual control for 10+ markets without consuming header space.
components.css: .ds-language-trigger { min-width: 200px; height: 48px; border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.72); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.96), rgba(241,245,249,.94)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95), 0 12px 28px rgba(71,85,95,.10); }

components.name: Product Stage
components.description: Hero carousel staging system for large angled truck imagery.
components.css: .ds-product-stage { perspective: 1100px; transform-style: preserve-3d; } .ds-product-stage img { transform: translateZ(58px) rotateX(1deg) rotateY(-2deg); filter: drop-shadow(0 42px 42px rgba(71,85,95,.28)); }
